text:
analyze the current bet star rating system and optimize it as follows:
1) make a single rating system that combines all factors into one star rating, and remove the current "after your history this is x stars" 
2) consider which types of bets won the most from all available data on my bets and historical bets from apis, such as overs, unders, favorites, underdogs, types of prop bets, etc. and for all profitable bet types, add to the star rating in a meaningful and proportionate way
3) for all historically losing bets based on my history or historical data from apis,  demote the star rating in a proportionate way. 
4) consider the amount of books which agree that a bet is positive ev for the rating 
5) consider whether at least one sharp book agrees that a bet is positive EV for the rating
6) consider the amount of positive EV for the rating 
7) consider all relevant factors which tend to make a bet beat clv based on my data or historical data from apis, including but not limited to, time before game starts, type of bet, sport, sharp books price, whether books offer both sides of the bet, and any other information from my data or Claude analysis or historical data from apis.

the goal is for you to use all available and searchable information and data to find the most profitable types of bets and make an accurate star rating system for the scanners in this app. keep the same stars system as it is , but adjust it for maximum accuracy based on a concurrence of data and Claude research. 5 stars should be a bet which is most profitable based on history and data and the type of bet scanned and 1 Star is the least profitable or risky
